    Cisco Secure Access provides protection against threats on the internet such as malware, phishing, and ransomware.

    Consumer

    Why users love OpenDNS

    Delivers faster, more reliable home internet

    Thanks to our global data centers and peering partnerships, we shorten the routes between every network and our data centers–making your internet access even faster.

    Helps make the web a safer place

    With filtering or pre-configured protection, you can safeguard your family against adult content and more. It’s the easiest way to add parental and content filtering controls to every device in your home.

    Easy to set up

    Get OpenDNS up and running in your home quickly and easily. PhD in Computer Science not required. Thanks to our helpful guides and knowledge base, set up is a breeze.

    Improving the internet since 2006

    OpenDNS was founded in 2006 with the mission to provide a safer, faster, and better internet browsing experience for all users. Initially, OpenDNS provided a recursive DNS service for use at home, and in 2009 introduced a service for the enterprise market. In 2012, OpenDNS launched an enterprise security product, called Umbrella. Its rapid success and customer adoption led to OpenDNS being acquired by Cisco in 2015.

    Today, our OpenDNS-branded products are designed to provide consumers with safer, faster, and more reliable internet in their homes. Our enterprise security product, is now branded Cisco Secure Access. Learn more about Cisco Secure Access.
